heading.en: Origins, war service and joining the DAP

body.zh-Hant: 希特勒1889年4月20日生於上奧地利的布勞瑙（因河畔），是海關官員阿洛伊斯·希特勒之子。第一次世界大戰期間他志願從軍，主要擔任傳令兵，隸屬巴伐利亞後備步兵第16團。1919年9月起他在慕尼黑加入德意志工人黨，黨員編號555。他於1920年3月31日自國防軍退伍，此後專心從事黨務。
body.en: Hitler was born on 20 April 1889 in Braunau am Inn, Upper Austria, the son of the customs official Alois Hitler. In the First World War he served as a volunteer, mainly as a dispatch runner, in the Bavarian Reserve Infantry Regiment No. 16. From September 1919 he was a member of the German Workers' Party in Munich, with membership number 555. He was discharged from the Reichswehr on 31 March 1920 and from then on devoted himself exclusively to party work.

heading.zh-Hant: 黨魁、慕尼黑政變與重建黨
heading.en: Party leader, the Munich putsch and refounding of the party

body.zh-Hant: 1921年7月29日，納粹黨（NSDAP）臨時黨員大會選希特勒為第一任黨主席，他並取得獨裁性質的全權。1923年11月8至9日，他與魯登道夫發動的慕尼黑政變失敗。1924年4月1日，他在慕尼黑人民法院因叛國罪被判五年要塞監禁，同日送入蘭茨貝格監獄，其間開始撰寫《我的奮鬥》第一卷，同年12月20日提前獲釋。1925年2月27日他重建NSDAP，此後擔任黨主席至1945年。
body.en: On 29 July 1921 an extraordinary members' meeting of the NSDAP elected Hitler its first chairman, with dictatorial powers. The Munich putsch he launched with Ludendorff on 8-9 November 1923 failed. On 1 April 1924 the Munich People's Court sentenced him for high treason to five years of fortress detention, and he was taken to Landsberg prison the same day; there he began writing the first volume of Mein Kampf, and he was released early on 20 December 1924. He refounded the NSDAP on 27 February 1925 and remained party chairman until 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 重建後的納粹黨在1930年9月的國會選舉中得票逾六百萬。1932年2月26日希特勒取得德國國籍，同年春天他在總統選舉中對上興登堡，得票超過三分之一。7月31日國會選舉後納粹黨成為最大黨團，但他8月13日要求出任總理，被興登堡拒絕。1933年1月30日，他被任命為保守派主導、僅三名納粹黨人入閣的聯合內閣總理。
body.en: In the Reichstag election of September 1930 the refounded Nazi Party won more than six million votes. Hitler obtained German citizenship on 26 February 1932 and in the spring of that year ran against Hindenburg for the presidency, winning more than a third of the votes. After the Reichstag election of 31 July the NSDAP was the strongest group, but on 13 August Hindenburg rejected his demand to be appointed Chancellor. On 30 January 1933 he was appointed Chancellor of a conservative-led coalition cabinet with only three National Socialists.

body.zh-Hant: 任總理後，1933年3月24日授權法在除社民黨與已被排除的共產黨之外的各黨支持下通過。1934年8月2日興登堡逝世；依前一日簽署的法律，希特勒合併總統與總理職權，稱「元首兼總理」，軍隊也改向他個人宣誓。1938年2月4日他撤換軍方高層，親自接掌國防軍統帥權。1939年9月1日德軍進攻波蘭，第二次世界大戰爆發。1941年12月19日他兼任陸軍總司令。1945年4月30日他在柏林總理府地下掩體自殺。
body.en: After he became Chancellor, the Enabling Act was passed on 24 March 1933 with the votes of all parties except the SPD and the already eliminated KPD. When Hindenburg died on 2 August 1934, Hitler, under a law signed the day before, united the offices of President and Chancellor under the title Führer und Reichskanzler, and the armed forces were sworn to him personally. On 4 February 1938 he dismissed the military leadership and took over supreme command of the Wehrmacht himself. The German attack on Poland on 1 September 1939 began the Second World War. From 19 December 1941 he was also commander-in-chief of the Army. On 30 April 1945 he killed himself in the bunker beneath the Reich Chancellery in Berlin.

body.zh-Hant: 史達林生於1878年12月18日（一說1879年12月21日），出生地為格魯吉亞的哥里，原名約瑟夫·維薩里奧諾維奇·朱加施維利（Dschugaschwili）。1894年進入第比利斯東正教神學院，1898年成為俄國社會民主工黨黨員，次年因參與革命活動被神學院開除。1903年黨分裂後，他站到列寧領導的布爾什維克一邊；1912年列寧欣賞他的組織才能，召他進入布爾什維克中央委員會。
body.en: Stalin was born on 18 December 1878 (by another account 21 December 1879) in Gori, Georgia, as Josef Vissarionovich Dzhugashvili. He entered the Orthodox seminary in Tiflis in 1894, became a member of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party in 1898 and was expelled from the seminary the next year for taking part in revolutionary activities. After the party split in 1903 he sided with the Bolsheviks under Lenin; in 1912 Lenin, who valued him as a brilliant organiser, called him into the Bolshevik Central Committee.

body.zh-Hant: 1917至1923年間，史達林在列寧的布爾什維克政府中先任民族事務人民委員；1919至1922年又任工農檢查人民委員，負責監督政府決議的執行並參與人事決定。1919年黨重組後，他成為政治局與組織局的成員，是唯一同時列席兩個領導機構的人。1922年新設總書記一職，由他出任，他並將之經營成黨內權力的關鍵；俄羅斯學者茹科夫（Ю. Н. Жуков）記他自1922年4月3日起任黨中央總書記。
body.en: From 1917 to 1923 Stalin served in Lenin's Bolshevik government first as People's Commissar for Nationalities, and from 1919 to 1922 as People's Commissar for Workers' and Peasants' Inspection, overseeing the execution of government decisions and taking part in personnel decisions. After the party's reorganisation in 1919 he was a member of both the Politburo and the Orgburo, the only person to sit on both. In 1922 the newly created post of General Secretary went to him, and he built it into the key to his power in the party; the Russian historian Yu. N. Zhukov records him as General Secretary of the party Central Committee from 3 April 1922.

heading.en: Consolidation of power and the Great Purge

body.zh-Hant: 列寧去世後，史達林保有其職務（1924至1929年），並憑藉權力地位逐一排除競爭對手。1929年起他推動農業強制集體化；1934至1939年的「大清洗」剷除所有潛在與被指為對手的人。1939年蘇聯與德意志國簽訂互不侵犯條約。德國國家圖書館的權威檔把1927至1953年稱為他在蘇聯的獨裁時期。
body.en: After Lenin's death Stalin kept his offices (1924-1929) and used his position of power to eliminate his rivals one after another. From 1929 he pushed through forced collectivisation of agriculture, and in the Great Purge of 1934-1939 he destroyed all potential and alleged opponents. In 1939 the USSR concluded a non-aggression pact with the German Reich. The German National Library authority record describes 1927 to 1953 as the period of his dictatorship over the Soviet Union.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年5月6日史達林出任人民委員會議主席。德軍入侵後，國家國防委員會（ГКО）於6月30日成立，由他任主席；7月19日他兼國防人民委員，8月8日任蘇聯武裝力量最高統帥。該委員會的決議具有法律效力，至1945年9月4日才正式解散。1945年在雅爾達與波茨坦會議上，他的擴張性權力企圖得以貫徹。
body.en: On 6 May 1941 Stalin became Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars. After the German invasion the State Defense Committee (GKO) was created on 30 June, with Stalin as chairman; on 19 July he also became People's Commissar for Defense and on 8 August Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the armed forces of the USSR. The committee's decisions had the force of law, and it was formally dissolved only on 4 September 1945. In 1945, at the Yalta and Potsdam conferences, his expansionist drive for power prevailed.
